description: This file contains utility functions and constants for installing and managing Apache Spark, including version checks, download procedures, and mirror retrieval, used in setup.py.

methods.name: checked_package_name
methods.description: Generates package name based on Spark, Hadoop, and Hive versions.

methods.name: checked_versions
methods.description: Validates and formats Spark, Hadoop, and Hive version strings.

methods.name: convert_old_hadoop_version
methods.description: Converts Hadoop version strings for Spark versions <= 3.2.

methods.name: install_spark
methods.description: Downloads and installs Spark for specified versions into a destination directory.

methods.name: get_preferred_mirrors
methods.description: Retrieves preferred Apache mirror URLs for downloading.

methods.name: download_to_file
methods.description: Downloads data from a response object to a file with progress output.
